lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the gill slits. The highest-intensity maxima are concentrated in four primary horizontal rows within the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple high-contrast, elongated subjects (remoras) is visible attached to or swimming in immediate proximity to the ventral-lateral region, posterior to the pectoral fin.
